latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — provides a comprehensive toolkit and agent-guided protocol for making tallow candles off-grid.

- Offers automated recipe generation, safety protocols, and timeline tracking for every batch.
- Calculates exact fat-to-wick ratios, pour temperatures, and burn-time predictions.
- Includes templates for inventory, daily curing logs, and barter/trade scripts.
- Divides labor: agent handles planning, math, and reminders; human performs hands-on steps.
- Built-in troubleshooting and decision trees for burn, curing, and safety issues.
- Tracks production metrics and suggests next-batch improvements for consistent success.
